messages:
anya: Incoming pen-test intake from RedTeam scheduled 2026-05-04. Need to confirm KMS rotation window, RBAC temporary roles, and retest slots. TL;DR: assessors need read-only access to logs + ability to trigger model runs, no write, 6h window.

kiran: +1. For KMS, we can create an ephemeral key grant with limited decrypt for that window. Question: do we rotate CMK before or after? rotating during window will break proofs.

leo: don't rotate during window. Create alias com.redwood.pt.assessors and use KMS Grant scoped to the role. Schedule key rotation 24h after window.

devon: For RBAC, propose ephemeral role `pt_assessor` with scoped perms: logs.read, models.invoke:read-only, s3:GetObject for evidence. Sample policy:

devon: ```json
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["logs:GetLogEvents","logs:DescribeLogGroups"],"Resource":"arn:aws:logs:*:123456789:log-group:/redwood/*"},
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::pt-evidence/*"},
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["inference:InvokeModel"],"Resource":"arn:aws:inference:*:123456789:model/*","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"inference:Mode":"read-only"}}}
  ]
}
```

michelle: Audit logging: we need 90d retention for assessor access per compliance. We'll export relevant log groups to the secure archive bucket and store a manifest with sha256.

security-bot: PT-1453 created (Pen test intake: KMS/RBAC/export) — assignees: devon, leo, michelle. Due 2026-05-01.

anya: Retest coordination: propose retest slots 2026-05-05 09:00-12:00 UTC and 13:00-16:00 UTC. Who owns scheduling?

kiran: I'll own scheduling and calendar invites. Devon owns RBAC PR, Leo owns KMS grants, Michelle owns audit export.

devon: I'll open RBAC terraform PR and tag @kiran for review. Terraform snippet:

devon: ```hcl
resource "aws_iam_role" "pt_assessor" {
  name = "redwood-pt-assessor"
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.assume.json
}

resource "aws_iam_policy" "pt_assessor_policy" {
  name   = "redwood-pt-assessor-policy"
  policy = file("policies/pt_assessor.json")
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "attach" {
  role       = aws_iam_role.pt_assessor.name
  policy_arn = aws_iam_policy.pt_assessor_policy.arn
}
```

leo: One blocker: our KMS proxy currently only issues grants up to 7 days. For a 6h window it's fine but confirm the grant API path. If proxy can't do per-request grants, we'll generate a pre-signed decrypt token gated by time.

michelle: Evidence packaging checklist: timestamped manifest, signed with key-id, include object-level sha256, and store manifests in `s3://pt-evidence/manifests/` with restricted ACL. We'll also need presigned URLs for assessor downloads.

anya: Action items summary — (1) devon: open RBAC PR and link policy file (PT-1453) (2) leo: create kms alias + grant and document rotation timing (3) michelle: set up export + 90d retention and manifest signing (4) kiran: schedule retest slots & send invites (5) dry-run call 15m on 2026-05-03 16:00 UTC. :calendar:

kiran: Creating invites now. I'll also add a short agenda for the dry-run (role activation, grant validation, sample evidence download).

security-bot: Reminder: run baseline IDS dry-run 2026-05-04T08:00:00Z — add to PT-1453.

anya: Thanks all. Tagging @devex for SDK guidance on limited model invocation and any client cert requirements.

devex: Happy to help — will post a sample client snippet for read-only inference calls and token scoping later today.

leo: Noted. I'll also export a test decrypt flow and share logs for the dry-run.

michelle: I'll prepare the manifest signing script and upload to PT-1453.

anya: Perfect — closing out here unless blockers crop up. Keep updates in PT-1453 and ping me if you need escalation. :lock:
